description: A private vault in {location} holds a ledger our client would rather nobody read. Take the ledger. Leave the money — taking it turns a quiet job into a manhunt.
hint: Nobody should hear the door open.

description: A crew running counterfeit papers out of {location} has a new supplier, and our client wants a name. Get inside, stay inside long enough to hear it.
hint: They will check who you say you are.

description: A mid-level official in {location} wants out, and has about a day before the people he works for notice. Get him across a border. Any border.
hint: He will not be able to keep up.

description: The only person willing to testify against a cartel accountant is being held in a clinic outside {location}. She is alive. That is expected to change.
hint: She will not be walking out on her own.

description: A broker in {location} has been selling the same intelligence to four governments. Two of them have now paid us. It should read as a medical event.
hint: A body found is a job half done.

description: A safehouse on the edge of {location} is holding equipment that belongs to our client. The people holding it are not negotiating.
hint: There is no quiet version of this.

description: Rent the apartment across from a target in {location} and find out who visits. Two weeks, compressed into however long you can stand it.
hint: You will need eyes where a person cannot stand.

description: Two parties are signing something in {location} this week that our client would prefer stayed unsigned. Nobody needs to be hurt. The deal needs to die.
hint: Money talks, but so does a leaked draft.

description: A client’s daughter is attending a function in {location} that three separate people have reason to disrupt. She is not to know we are there.
hint: Standing between her and it is the whole job.

description: One of ours has been sitting in a facility outside {location} for six weeks. The official position is that he was never there.
hint: Three problems: the wall, the system, and the walk back.

description: A client’s office in {location} has a leak. Four candidates, one week, and they cannot know they are being looked at.
hint: People tell you more when they think they are choosing to.

description: Collect a sealed case in {location} and deliver it two districts over. Routine, badly paid, and always available.
A private table in {location} is where a certain account number gets spoken aloud once a month. Buy in, sit down, listen.
hint: You need to belong at that table.

description: A light aircraft went into the water off {location} carrying something our client insured and would like back before anyone else finds it.
hint: The hard part is the breathing.

description: A journalist in {location} has forty-eight hours before she publishes and a list of people who would rather she did not. The client was explicit: nobody dies over this. Nobody.
hint: The client will read the report. Choose who you send.
